continuity_objects.purpose: Every imported claim/source/task/decision as witness or candidate continuity object.

vector_search.gate: Only query documents with inheritance_status == INHERITABLE_AFTER_RECEIPT for next-session inheritance.

settlement_queue.purpose: Operator review queue for candidate objects.

sessions.purpose: Session metadata and context package pointers.

domain_registry.purpose: Optional domain cards and graph regions for later project ingestion.

non_claims: This schema does not create remote Atlas collections in sandbox.
Vector index creation must be validated in MongoDB Atlas or through MongoDB MCP in the judged build.
